locations.title: Bundergat Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- To build the Bundergat wonder weapon, there will be four parts needed:
   - The Hammer
      - First, grab the [SO3](#loc=551384) vial from the second floor of the yellow house.
      - Take the SO3 vial to the [Kitchen Sink](#loc=551385) in the green house to create H2SO4.
      - In the present, find the [mannequin](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-paradox-junction?search=category:14165) that is emitting a humming sound.
         - Note: The mannequin might be down the street past the truck that needs to be moved in the main quest to access the Pack-a-Punch.
      - Head to the past and pour the vial onto the same mannequin.
      - Head back to the present and the hammer will be in the same location that the mannequin was.
   - The Stock
      - In the present, find the [black ooze](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-paradox-junction?search=black_ooze) on one of the walls that is emitting a humming sound.
         - Note: The black ooze might be down the street past the truck that needs to be moved in the main quest to access the Pack-a-Punch.
      - Head to the past and use an explosive on the wall where the black ooze was.
      - Head back to the present and you'll find the stock in the hole where the black ooze used to be.
   - The Barrel
      - In the present, find the cyst on one of the walls that is emitting a humming sound.
      - Kill zombies near the cyst until the cyst dies and drops the barrel.
   - [The Sealant](#loc=551386)
- After collecting all four parts, head to the [Workbench](#loc=550693) inside the truck in the road and melee it.
- Insert each part and build the Bundergat.

locations.title: Sundergat Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, build the [Bundergat](#loc=550732).
- After acquiring the Bundergat, fight through a few rounds in the present until a fire tornado spawns.
- Approach the fire tornado and bring the zombie inside of it to the [Workbench](#loc=550642) in the truck.
- Kill the zombie near the workbench to power it up.
- Repeat this for two more rounds until the workbench is fully powered up.
- Head to the past and place the Bundergat into the [Workbench](#loc=550693).
- Finally, travel back to the present and head to the workbench to retrieve the Sundergat.

locations.title: Paradox Junction Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, build the [Bundergat](#loc=550732) and upgrade it to the [Sundergat](#loc=552259).
- In the past, shoot at the swing in the swing set in the back yard of the yellow house and pick up the swing seat.
- Head to the present and find the [RC-XD Controller](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-paradox-junction?search=RC-XD) around the map in one of three places.
- Pilot the RC-XD into the garage and blow up the red canister in the corner.
- Head down the street past where the truck was and enter the newly opened garage.
- After watching the zombie disappear, pick up the [Chalk](#loc=550796) that was left behind.
- Head to the playground again, now in the present, and place the swing and the chalk on the swing set.
- These next three steps can be done in any order and all at the same time. The goal of each is to play a game with the twins, which will spawn a gold item. You'll need to kill zombies with the wonder weapon near the gold item to take each of them to their final destination.
   - Music Sheet:
      - In the present, head to the backyard of the green house. Eventually, a zombie named the Piano Teacher will spawn.
      - Use an item to cause the Piano Teacher to become friendly and it'll start heading towards the piano in the house.
      - As it is heading there, teleport to the past and head back to the [Piano](#loc=551395).
      - The Piano Teacher will go to the piano and explode.
      - Head back to the present and there will now be eight note symbols around the map, each one blinking between one to eight times.
      - Note where each of the locations are and interact with them in order from one to eight.
      - Head back to the past and go to the piano. There will now be symbols above it.
      - Interact with the piano and play **86756535**.
      - Head back to the present and find three floating zombies outside the map behind the green and/or yellow houses. Shoot all three.
      - Head to the [X](#loc=551396) on the ground down the road and stand on it until it glows.
      - Head back to the past and stand in the newly formed [O](#loc=551397).
      - Interact with the ball and start the trial, requiring you to kill the zombies before they land back on the ground.
      - Once done, the golden music sheet will appear.
   - Music Box
      - In the present, head to the garage of the yellow house and interact with the red box on the shelf to acquire the [Irradiated Seeds](#loc=551389).
      - Head back to the past and place the seeds in the [empty mound](#loc=551390) in front of a house.
      - Kill zombies near the tree using the wonder weapon until the tree is grown enough.
      - Head back to the present and head to the tree.
      - Throw three combat axes at the tree to acquire it's logs.
      - Head to the past and place the logs into the [Fireplace](#loc=551391) of the yellow house and light it on fire.
      - Head to the present and stand on the [X](#loc=551393) until it glows, then head back to the past.
      - After the twins use the chalk to make the [Hopscotch](#loc=551394), jump on each number up to twelve then back down to one without jumping on the black mist.
      - Doing so successfully will spawn the golden music box.
   - Cymbals
      - In the present, use the perk Death Perception to find an invisible headset in the map and pick them up, either on the coat rack on the second floor of the green house, in front of the green house near the car, or in the mannequin's hand next to the [Random Perk Machine](#loc=550677).
      - Next, there will be a set of [Goggles](#loc=940405) on top of a [Speaker Pole](#loc=551399) at the end of the street.
      - Shoot the goggles that are on top of the speaker pole to knock them down, then use a wisp from the Wisp Tea perk to grab the goggles and bring them into the map.
      - Head back to the past and interact with the [Toybox](#loc=551400) on the side walk and place the headphones and goggles inside.
      - Head to the present and stand on top of the [X](#loc=551401) until it glows.
      - Hidden around the map is a red ball, either on top of the back porch of the yellow house, on top of one of the non-yellow or green houses, or on top of a crate on the street.
      - Shoot the ball and keep shooting it until it's on top of the X.
      - Head to the past and to the backyard of the green house and interact with the [Four Square](#loc=551402) game.
      - Keep the ball from bouncing in the same square twice or outside the squares until the game is over, spawning the golden cymbals.
- After all three main steps are done, head to the present and set the timer on the tower to be at 0:00.
- Head back to the past and, while in the animation, shoot at the red hand with the wonder weapon, which spawns an orb between the bus and the truck in the middle of the road.
- Follow it to the backyard swing set and interact with the portal to start the boss fight.

locations.title: Mini Golf Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- In the past, in the back yard of the yellow house, there is a [Mini Golf](#loc=550785) area.
- Shoot the ball into the hole to receive some free power ups.

locations.title: Scary TV Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Note: This easter egg jumpscares the person who interacts with the television at the end of the puzzle**

**Steps:**
- In the past, interact with the [Television](#loc=550787) on the second floor of the green house.
- Head outside and there will be a red orb floating in the air around the house.
- Shoot at the antenna until it aligns with the red orb.
- Go back inside the house and interact with the television.

locations.title: Clock Tower Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- In the present, look at the clock tower and shoot the small hand so it lines up with 0 and the long hand so it lines up a quarter to the right past it.
- Head to the past to receive a variety of rewards near the green house.

locations.title: Suitcase Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, get the perk Death Perception and head to the past.
- Around the map are hanging flower pots. With Death Perception, find the one with the key outline inside and break it.
- Repeat this four more times then head to the [Suitcase](#loc=550788) on the second floor of the green house to unlock it.

locations.title: Melted Mannequins Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- With the H2SO4 that you created during the [Bundergat Easter Egg](#loc=550732), head to the past and use it on all twelve [mannequins](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-paradox-junction?search=category:14165) throughout the map.
   - Each vial only contains enough H2SO4 to use it on three mannequins at a time, requiring a minimum of four trips.
- Once done, head to the present and a free random perk will spawn on the last mannequin that was melted.

locations.title: Mannequin Head Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, complete the [Bundergat Easter Egg](#loc=550732).
- Then, head to the past and interact with the [Mannequin Head](#loc=550790) on the floor on the second floor of the green house.
- Follow it to different headless mannequins throughout the map and kill zombies near it to harvest their souls.
- After doing this three times, the last mannequin will explode, dropping loot.

locations.title: Weeping Mannequin Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, complete the [Bundergat Easter Egg](#loc=550732).
- Then, head to the present and you'll find the [Scary Manniquen](#loc=550791) just outside the map.
- Look at the mannequin for a few seconds and it'll start to teleport and chase you.
- Head to the past and it'll teleport to a location around the map.
- Find the mannequin and shoot it's head for loot.

locations.title: Purple Cyst Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, complete the [Bundergat Easter Egg](#loc=550732).
- Then, in the present, there is a [Purple Cyst](#loc=959202) that will appear.
- There are a variety of items around the map that can be placed in front of it and, depending on the items, a HVT will appear and drop a free perk.
   - Speed Cola (And a free Pack-A-Punch):
      - [Guts](#loc=550799)
      - [Ham](#loc=550792)
      - [Battery](#loc=550793)
      - [Bucket](#loc=550795)
      - [Head](#loc=550797)

      - [Dog Collar](#loc=550794)

   - Vulture Aid

   - Quick Revive

   - Deadshot Daiquiri
      - [Bone](#loc=550798)

      - [Head](#loc=550797)

locations.title: Paradox Junction Super Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- After heading to the past, use Aether Shroud and interact with the [Chest Drawing](#loc=959180) on the garage door in the Cul-de-Sac.
- Afterwards, head up to the second floor of the yellow house and throw a Psych Grenade at the question mark on the wall to obtain the [Toy Box Key](#loc=959181).
- Interact with the Chest Drawing to spawn in the Toy Box, then you'll need to find three Ms. Peeks parts around the map. There are six spawns that could show up:
   - [Ms. Peeks Part](#loc=959187)
   - [Ms. Peeks Part](#loc=959188)
   - [Ms. Peeks Part](#loc=959205)
   - [Ms. Peeks Part](#loc=959207)
   - [Ms. Peeks Part](#loc=959218)
   - [Ms. Peeks Part](#loc=959224)
- Afterwards, interact with the [Ms. Peeks Part Circle](#loc=959206) on top of the bus, then quickly find Ms. Peeks over and over again until complete.
- Pick up the Ms. Peeks toy at the Ms. Peeks Part Circle and place it in the Toy Box to obtain the Twins Toy, then Exfil.
